options.name: File exchange
options.direction: Two file silhouettes fragment into rectangular pieces that interchange between the documents.
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ClipShare logo concept board with matching favicon and PWA app-icon previews.
Input image: the attached image is a reference for the clean presentation layout, blue palette, and friendly ClipShare wordmark. Replace the linked-chain symbol everywhere with a NEW symbol of two files transferring rectangular chunks to each other.
Primary request: TWO clearly recognizable upright file/document silhouettes side by side, one strong blue #1a73e8 and one light blue #8ab4f8. Each has a small simple folded top corner. Their facing inner edges split into a few broad rectangular chunks. Those rectangular pieces visibly travel across the central gap and fit into the other file: deep-blue rectangles move from the left document into the light-blue document, and light-blue rectangles move from the right document into the deep-blue document. Show this as two staggered rows of interchanging rectangular tiles, one row travelling each way. The geometry itself should suggest the interchange. The pieces must look like fragments of the file bodies, rather than confetti, particles, dots, or decorative rectangles around intact documents.
Style: clean, friendly, precise flat vector-like logo geometry, crisp edges, gently rounded corners, bold uncomplicated silhouette, ample negative space. Keep only a FEW LARGE rectangles so the idea remains readable in a favicon. Use the small folded corners and overall rectangular document bodies to keep both files identifiable even while fragmented. Do not draw paper-content lines.
Composition: one square white concept board. Top-left small label EXACTLY "11 File exchange". Upper half: new symbol to the left of EXACT wordmark "ClipShare", charcoal #202124 "Clip", blue #1a73e8 "Share", friendly bold clean sans serif matching the reference. Lower half: smaller standalone version of the identical new symbol on the left with label "Favicon"; on the right a solid blue rounded-square PWA icon carrying a white reversed version of the identical document-and-interchanging-rectangles symbol with label "App icon". Preserve comfortable PWA safe-area padding. Keep symbol geometry consistent across all three representations. No other text.
Constraints: exactly two document bodies; visibly shared/interchanged rectangular chunks; flat blue palette only; no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no mockup devices, no textures, no motion blur, no thin connectors, no conventional chain-link emblem, no arrow overlay, no watermark. This is a professional logo proposal, not an explanatory diagram.
